## Problem

What reusable problem should the toolkit solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the public API, CLI behavior, data shape, or MCP tool you would like.

## Why this belongs in the toolkit

Explain who could reuse it beyond a single private trading strategy.

## Data-source and licensing considerations

If the feature depends on an external data source, document the authoritative source, access method, licensing/terms considerations, expected update frequency, and failure behavior.

## Scope boundaries

This project does not accept brokerage credentials, private trading strategies, order-execution features, or datasets that cannot legally be redistributed.
